subtasks.description: Declare a 4-bit register rcnt, a 32-bit register out, and a 32-bit wire next_rcon that connects the combinational lookup to the sequential block.
Combinational lookup from rcnt to 32-bit next_rcon using a precomputed table. For rcnt 0-9 output the round constant with lower 24 bits zero; for rcnt>9 output 32'h00000000.
constraints: Must exactly match the constants in S011: 0x01000000 for rcnt=0, 0x02000000 for 1, ..., 0x1B000000 for rcnt=9.

subtasks.description: Sequential update on posedge clk: if kld==1 set rcnt=0 and out=next_rcon (which corresponds to rcnt=0, i.e., 0x01000000); otherwise rcnt increments (4-bit wrap) and out samples next_rcon.
constraints: Use synchronous reset/load only via kld; no asynchronous reset.
out must be registered and change only on clock edge.
